BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-ResidueNotes
BundleInfo.Author: Oliver Clarke
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Read, browse, edit, and export Coot residue, region, and positional notes in mmCIF files.
BundleInfo.Description: Annotate residues, single-chain regions, and spatial positions in molecular structures. Browse nearby notes around the center of rotation, navigate with range selection and temporary point markers, and exchange annotations with Coot Trimmings using annotated mmCIF or export a Markdown report. Saving annotations is explicit; ordinary model/session saving is not modified.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: Tool :: Residue Notes :: General :: Browse residue annotations embedded in mmCIF files
Tool :: Nearby Notes :: General :: Read nearby residue annotations around the center of rotation
Command :: resnotes :: General :: Open the Residue Notes tool
Command :: nearby_notes :: General :: Open the Nearby Notes tool
Command :: resnotes import :: General :: Import residue notes from an mmCIF file
Command :: resnotes export :: General :: Export an annotated mmCIF file
